name: Report library
description: Public threat intelligence advisories available for one-click ingestion. All are published by CISA and are US Government works in the public domain. They are NOT committed to this repository: the PDFs are fetched on first use and cached, which keeps the repo small and avoids redistributing several megabytes of third-party files.

reports.title: Akira Ransomware
reports.description: Akira has hit over 250 organisations and claimed ~$42M in proceeds. Rich hash tables, a long tool list (Mimikatz, AnyDesk, RClone) and 8 exploited CVEs.

reports.title: Black Basta Ransomware
reports.description: Ransomware-as-a-service affecting 500+ organisations across critical infrastructure, including healthcare.

reports.title: RansomHub Ransomware
reports.description: RaaS formerly Cyclops and Knight. Over 110 published URLs, making it the best fixture for URL extraction.

reports.title: CL0P Ransomware — MOVEit Exploitation
reports.description: CL0P's mass exploitation of CVE-2023-34362 in MOVEit Transfer. Heavy on hashes, domains and web shells.

reports.title: Medusa Ransomware
reports.description: Double-extortion RaaS affecting 300+ critical infrastructure victims.

reports.title: LockBit 3.0 — Citrix Bleed
reports.description: LockBit affiliates exploiting CVE-2023-4966 (Citrix Bleed) to hijack sessions and bypass MFA.

reports.title: Volt Typhoon — PRC State-Sponsored
reports.description: PRC actors pre-positioning in US critical infrastructure using living-off-the-land techniques. Long, behaviour-heavy prose rather than IOC tables.

reports.title: Andariel — North Korean Espionage
reports.description: DPRK group targeting defence, aerospace and nuclear sectors for military and nuclear intelligence.

reports.title: Iranian Brute Force and Credential Access
reports.description: Iranian actors using brute force and MFA push-bombing against healthcare, energy and government.

reports.title: Russian SVR — JetBrains TeamCity
reports.description: SVR (APT29 / Cozy Bear) exploiting CVE-2023-42793 in JetBrains TeamCity for supply-chain access.
